cannedFoodSodiumNote: At Walmart Lake City (2026-10-18, from search results) the only no-salt-added canned vegetables found were cut green beans and crushed tomatoes (plus the no-salt-added diced tomatoes already listed). Other canned vegetables (mixed vegetables, carrots, spinach, mushrooms, potatoes) are regular: drain and rinse them, but this only removes about 7-21% of the sodium in canned vegetables (Haytowitz 2011, USDA ARS), much less than the about 41% for canned beans (Duyff 2011), so frozen vegetables are the first choice. Canned beans other than kidney beans were not low sodium: drain and rinse.
